title: Mobile Engineering & Product Testing (MEPT)
summary: Design, engineer, validate and certify intelligent products across devices, applications and ecosystems.
body_markdown:
How can enterprises accelerate connected product innovation without compromising quality or time to market?


**Organisations building mobile and connected product experiences must balance speed, quality, compliance and user expectations across fragmented devices, platforms and ecosystems. Mobile engineering, product testing and AI-powered quality engineering help reduce release risk, improve reliability and accelerate product commercialisation.**


How do enterprises build connected mobile experiences that scale?


Connected mobile experiences are built by bringing together applications, devices, connectivity, cloud services and user experiences into a seamless ecosystem. Scaling those experiences requires mobile application development, companion app engineering, platform expertise and quality assurance. Reusable assets such as MARC help accelerate enterprise-grade mobile application development, improving consistency, reducing engineering effort and speeding time to market.


What does end-to-end mobile engineering look like in practice?


End-to-end mobile engineering spans the entire lifecycle of a connected product—from strategy, UX and application development to testing, deployment, OTA upgrades and lifecycle support. By combining application, device and platform expertise within a single engineering model, organisations can deliver mobile experiences that evolve, perform and scale over time.


How can AI-powered quality engineering improve product reliability?


AI-powered quality engineering improves product reliability by embedding intelligence across the testing lifecycle. WEGA for Product Testing helps teams accelerate test design, automation, execution and analysis within existing test environments. By combining domain-aware testing, specialised regression qualification and autonomous testing capabilities, organisations can improve coverage, identify defects earlier and accelerate release readiness.


How can product teams accelerate certification, compliance and market readiness?


Product certification and compliance are often treated as the final hurdle before launch, creating delays, rework and unexpected risks. Leading teams accelerate market readiness by embedding certification readiness, interoperability testing, compliance validation and performance benchmarking throughout the product lifecycle. With **Tarang Lab** supporting product testing, compliance and certification requirements, organizations can streamline approvals, reduce commercialization risk and bring products to market faster.
